artifacts.command:
python - <<'PY'
import ast,datetime,hashlib,json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('course/training.md')
s=p.read_text()
t=re.search(r'(?m)^## T\.4 .*?(?=^## |\Z)',s,re.S|re.M)[0]
codes=re.findall(r'```python\n(.*?)```',t,re.S)
configs=[]
for c in codes:
 for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(c)):
  if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='ModelConfig':
   configs.append({k.arg:ast.literal_eval(k.value) for k in n.keywords})
assert configs==[{'width':32,'layers':1,'heads':1,'max_length':128}]
bash=re.findall(r'```bash\n(.*?)```',t,re.S)
commands=[line for b in bash for line in b.splitlines() if line.strip()]
command=next(c for c in commands if 'scripts/train.py --task text' in c)
assert '--device cpu' in command and '--steps 200' in command
fixed=next(c for c in commands if '--experiment text_foundation ' in c)
assert '--device cuda' in fixed
r={'checked_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(),'environment':{'python':sys.version.split()[0],'device':'none, static AST/source checks only'},'source':'course/training.md#T.4','section_sha256':hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest(),'parsed_start_config':configs[0],'cpu_text_command':command,'fixed_text_foundation_command':fixed,'limits':'Only static command/config recognition and comparison were executed; neither the 200-step nor the 600-step command was launched.'}
out=Path('docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/omni-technical-technical_5_1-v1/training-prerequisite-v1.json')
with out.open('x') as f:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
PY
